versions.content: MetaData support is required if J1939TpConnection.ac- ceptVariableDA is used The usage of J1939TpConnection.acceptVari- ableDA requires the support of COM Stack MetaData with MetaDataType = TAR- GET_ADDRESS_16. Please note that this affects only J1939TpConnection.tpPg. sdus that in turn are referenced by a PduTriggering that references an IPduPort with communicationDirection = in (in other words Rx Pdus).
